anchor_rule: Every sequence group with at least 16 measured proteins and at least 48 measured proteins outside it; 50 starts per eligible group; equal weight per anchor group.
threshold_rule: Full original task 90th percentile, evaluator only, ties included. Same threshold in both scenarios.
ablation_rule: Prediction-only; mean plus beta=1 bootstrap standard deviation; mean-rank plus weight=0.25 diversity-rank; existing combined rule. No parameter search.
diagnostic_rule: At the first shared decision only: correlation of bootstrap spread with absolute log1p error across all untested candidates; and error by uncertainty quartile. Diagnostic outcomes never enter a policy.
scope: Exploratory robustness and ablation extension after inspecting the original campaign results. Sequence groups are 60% identity connected components, not validated biological families. After the first acquired batch, new-group labels may train subsequent batches. Not permanent group holdout or external validation.
